name: SendEmailMessageThroughOutlook
label: Send Email Message Through Outlook
description: Sends an email message through Microsoft Outlook using real COM interop.

fields.name: OutlookApplication
fields.label: Outlook Application
fields.description: The Outlook Application object used to send the email.

fields.name: To
fields.label: Recipient(s)
fields.description: The email address(es) of the recipient(s). Separate multiple addresses by semicolons (;).

fields.name: CC
fields.label: CC Recipient(s)
fields.description: Optional: The CC email address(es), separated by semicolons (;).

fields.name: BCC
fields.label: BCC Recipient(s)
fields.description: Optional: The BCC email address(es), separated by semicolons (;).

fields.name: Subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: The subject line of the email message.

fields.name: Body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: The body content of the email message.

fields.name: BodyIsHtml
fields.label: Is Body HTML
fields.description: Determines whether the body should be interpreted as HTML.

fields.name: SaveAsDraft
fields.label: Save As Draft
fields.description: If true, the email is saved as a draft instead of being sent immediately.

fields.name: Attachments
fields.label: Attachments
fields.description: Full path of any attachment files. Multiple paths can be separated by spaces.
